title: Tilt-excess decay theorem (Simon 5.4.5)
statement: For n >= 1, l, p > n there are eta, delta_0 in (0,1/4] depending only on n,l,p such that: if U is open, V has generalized mean curvature H, AllardHypotheses H p delta rho hold with 0 < delta <= delta_0, sigma in (0, delta rho/2], xi in spt V cap B_{delta rho}(0) and T is an n-dimensional subspace, then there is an n-dimensional subspace S with E_*(xi, eta sigma, S) <= eta^(2(1 - n/p)) E_*(xi, sigma, T), where E_*(xi,sigma,T) = max{E(xi,sigma,T), delta^-1 (sigma^(p-n) integral_{B_sigma(xi)} |H|^p dmu_V)^(2/p)} (contract tiltExcessStar).
